code:
POLICY:    Privileged access must use multi-factor authentication.

STANDARD:  Privileged accounts require a FIDO2 hardware token
           or authenticator app. SMS MFA is not acceptable.
           Session timeout: 15 minutes of inactivity.

PROCEDURE: Open the identity provider admin console -> user's
           MFA settings -> Add method -> FIDO2 -> user registers
           token within 10 minutes before the link expires.
caption: Each level adds detail the one above it deliberately left out.
